npcs.name: Aranea Ienith
npcs.greet: The Lady of Twilight told me you would come. She tells me many things, at dusk and at dawn.

npcs.name: Jariel the Devoted
npcs.greet: Boethiah respects only strength, and betrayal is a kind of strength. Have you come to prove yours?

npcs.name: Sinding
npcs.greet: Don't look at me like that. I'm locked up for a reason, and I'm not proud of it.

npcs.name: Atub
npcs.greet: Largashbur is cursed. Our chief is too proud to ask the Furious One why. I am not.

npcs.name: Silus Vesuius
npcs.greet: Welcome to the Museum of the Mythic Dawn! Mind the robes; some of them are original.

npcs.name: Nelkir
npcs.greet: There's a door in the cellar that whispers. It tells me things about my father. Want to know what it says?

npcs.name: Tyranus of Stendarr
npcs.greet: There is something foul in that house. I can smell it. Help me cleanse it.

npcs.name: Eola
npcs.greet: You look hungry. Not for bread, I think. For something rarer.

npcs.name: Kesh the Clean
npcs.greet: Kesh tends the Taskmaster's shrine. Kesh is clean. The others? Not so clean.

npcs.name: Sam Guevenne
npcs.greet: A drinking contest! Win, and I'll give you a staff that'll make you famous. Lose, and you buy.

npcs.name: Dervenin
npcs.greet: My master is on vacation! He's in the head of a dead king, and he won't come out! Help a poor madman?

npcs.name: Erandur
npcs.greet: Dawnstar dreams badly, and every dream has the same mother. I know her name. I served her once.

relics.name: Azura's Star (tainted)
relics.desc: Malyn Varen's soul is trapped inside, souring the Star.

relics.name: The Rueful Axe
relics.desc: Clavicus Vile wants Barbas dead with it. Barbas would rather not.

relics.name: Oghma Infinium
relics.desc: Hermaeus Mora's book of all knowledge. Reading it changes the reader.

relics.name: Troll Fat Offering
relics.desc: A slab of fat cut from a living troll, for Malacath's shrine.

relics.name: Mehrunes' Razor: Hilt
relics.desc: One piece of the dagger of the Prince of Destruction.

relics.name: Mehrunes' Razor: Blade Shards
relics.desc: Broken shards of an impossibly sharp blade.

relics.name: Mehrunes' Razor: Pommel
relics.desc: A pommel stone that glows like a coal.

relics.name: Mephala's Blade (sleeping)
relics.desc: It grows sharper every time it betrays a friend.

relics.name: Meridia's Beacon
relics.desc: A glowing orb that pulls you, gently, toward the Statue to Meridia.

relics.name: Peryite's Incense
relics.desc: Vampire dust, silver, deathbell and ruby, burned together. It smells exactly like you'd expect.

relics.name: Sanguine's Invitation
relics.desc: A sticky note, mostly wine stains: 'Misty Grove. Bring the staff. Bring yourself.'

relics.name: Skull of Corruption
relics.desc: Vaermina's staff. It feeds on dreams.

azura: Child of the twilight. A sorcerer has stolen my Star and twisted it into a prison for his own soul. Find him in the drowned fort of Ilinalta's Deep, and cleanse it.
malyn: You've come for the Star? I am the Star now. Come in, if you like being destroyed.
boethiah: My champion grows soft. Kill him, take his place, and I will dress you in my mail. Betrayal is the only true virtue.
barbas: Hey, friend. Yes, the dog is talking. Name's Barbas. My master, Clavicus Vile, and I had a little disagreement. Help me get back to him?
The dog trots ahead toward Haemar's Shame, tail wagging, as if it knows exactly where you're going.
clavicus: You brought back my dog. Wonderful. Now kill him with the axe, and I'll give you the Masque. Or give me back the axe and keep your sentimental attachments.
Don't listen to him. I'm a good dog.
hermaeus: Knowledge is the only treasure that grows when shared, and the only treasure I keep for myself. Read, mortal. Read, and become more than you were.
hircine: Sinding stole my ring and cursed himself with it. A fine hunt: the hunted beast who wears my favor. Find him in Bloated Man's Grotto, and choose your prey.
malacath: Largashbur forgot me. Their chief grew fat and lazy. Bring me the troll's fat, kill the giant who mocks them, and I will remember Largashbur again.
dagon: The Razor is mine. Its pieces are scattered by thieves and scholars. Reforge it at my shrine, and offer me the fool who brought you there.
mephala: Little ears, little whispers. The Jarl's son hears me, and so do you. My blade sleeps in this palace. Wake it with a lie.
meridia: My temple is defiled by a necromancer who raises my honored dead as puppets. Purge Kilkreath, and Dawnbreaker will be yours.
molag: The priest came to cleanse my house. How charming. Bring him to me, and I'll give you something heavy.
namira: Eola keeps my old feast. Join it. Taste what others fear, and you will never hunger as they do.
peryite: The Taskmaster has a task. My afflicted wander from Bthardamz, led by a fallen elf named Orchendor. Order requires that he be ended.
sanguine: You remember a drinking contest. You remember a lot of mead. Then you remember nothing at all, until you wake in a temple with a headache like a dragon's footstep.
Ha! There you are. You were magnificent. Here, a souvenir of the best night anyone's had in a century.
sheogorath: Ah, a visitor! In the mind of Pelagius, of all places. He was so very interesting, before the strangling. Fix his little troubles and I'll go home. And you'll get a present!
Leave me alone! Not you too! The Night Terrors, the Confidence, the Anger! They're all in here with me!
sheogorath_isles: Splendid! You've earned a holiday. Come along, come along, mind the door. It bites. Only on Tuesdays.
A door that was not there a moment ago swings open on a sky of impossible colours.
sheogorath_palace: My Isles! My city! My cheese! Take the staff, little mortal, and spread a little madness. Now off you pop, I have a lunch to forget.
molag_coldharbour: You did well. Now see what you serve. Walk my city, and remember it when you sleep.
Chains lash out of the floor. The house folds away, and a black sky opens over burning ruins.
vaermina: You walk in my dream, little thing. Erandur betrayed me once. Will you betray him, and take my Skull?

quests.title: The Black Star
quests.offer: Who are you waiting for out here?
quests.pitch: For you, it seems. Azura has shown me your face. She has a task for you. Kneel at the shrine, and listen.
quests.desc: Azura's priestess Aranea Ienith says the Lady of Dusk and Dawn wants her Star cleansed. A sorcerer has corrupted it.

objectives.text: Destroy Malyn Varen's soul within the Star
Return the cleansed Star to Aranea
objectives.topic: Varen is gone. The Star is clean.
objectives.reply: Azura smiles on you. The Star is yours. It will hold any soul, endlessly, and never break.

quests.title: Boethiah's Calling
quests.pitch: A champion. Hers is weak. Climb to the Sacellum, let the Prince speak to you, and then kill the one she names.
quests.desc: The cultists of Boethiah serve a Prince of betrayal and murder. She wants a new champion, and the old one must die.

quests.title: A Daedra's Best Friend
quests.desc: A talking dog named Barbas found me near Falkreath. He says he's lost his master, the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile, and wants me to help him get home.

objectives.text: Follow the talking dog through Falkreath
Clear the vampires out of Haemar's Shame

quests.title: Discerning the Transmundane
quests.offer: Is there something else beneath the ice, Septimus?
quests.pitch: A box! A Dwemer box, sealed in the deeps, and what's inside it belongs to my master. Open it, bring me the Oghma. Bring it, bring it, bring it.
quests.desc: Septimus Signus wants me to open a Dwemer lockbox deep under Blackreach for his master, Hermaeus Mora.

objectives.text: Destroy the guardian of the Dwemer lockbox

quests.title: Ill Met by Moonlight
quests.pitch: I killed a girl. Not me. The beast. I took a ring that was supposed to help me control it, and Hircine cursed it. He'll come for me. Unless you hunt me first.
quests.desc: Sinding, a werewolf jailed in Falkreath, stole the Ring of Hircine. Now the Lord of the Hunt wants a hunt.

quests.title: The Cursed Tribe
quests.pitch: Malacath has turned from us. Our chief will not beg. You could. Bring troll fat to the shrine, and listen to what the Furious One wants.
quests.desc: The orcs of Largashbur are cursed. Their shaman Atub thinks Malacath wants an outsider's help.

objectives.text: Kill a troll and take its fat
Bring the troll fat to Atub
objectives.reply: Now place your hands on the shrine. He will speak.

objectives.text: Kill the giant chieftain who mocks Largashbur

quests.title: Pieces of the Past
quests.pitch: The Mythic Dawn, the cult that opened the gates of Oblivion! And I want the one thing missing from my collection: Mehrunes' Razor. It was broken into three pieces. Find them, and we'll meet at the shrine.
quests.desc: Silus Vesuius, a collector of Mythic Dawn relics, wants me to gather the three pieces of Mehrunes' Razor.

objectives.text: Recover the Razor's hilt from Cracked Tusk Keep
Recover the Razor's blade shards from Cliffside Retreat
Recover the Razor's pommel from Morvunskar
Meet Silus at the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon

quests.title: The Whispering Door
quests.pitch: It knows secrets. About my father, and about you. And it says there's a blade behind it, if somebody gets the key from Farengar. I can't. You can.
quests.desc: The Jarl's son Nelkir hears a whispering door in Dragonsreach's cellar. Behind it, the Daedric Prince Mephala's blade sleeps.

objectives.text: Get the key to the Whispering Door from Farengar
objectives.topic: I need the key to the cellar door.
objectives.reply: That door? The Jarl had it sealed for good reason. Fine. Take the key. I didn't give it to you.

objectives.text: Take Mephala's blade from the stand

quests.title: The Break of Dawn
quests.desc: I found a glowing beacon in a chest, and it pulls toward the Statue to Meridia on the coast of Haafingar.

objectives.text: Bring the beacon to the Statue to Meridia

quests.title: The House of Horrors
quests.pitch: It belongs to a Daedric Prince now. Molag Bal, I think. Come in with me. Whatever happens, keep your sword drawn.
quests.desc: A Vigilant of Stendarr asked me to help purge an abandoned house in Markarth. The Prince of Domination is waiting inside.

objectives.text: Enter the Abandoned House with the Vigilant
Bring Molag Bal's judgment to Logrolf the Willful
Answer the Prince of Domination's summons
Walk the burning streets of the Hollow City
Escape Coldharbour through the Dark Anchor

quests.title: The Taste of Death
quests.pitch: A feast of a kind few have the stomach for. First, Reachcliff Cave has been overrun by draugr. Clear it, and we'll talk about dinner.
quests.desc: A woman named Eola in Markarth wants my help reclaiming Reachcliff Cave for Namira's followers.

objectives.text: Clear the draugr from Reachcliff Cave

choices.label: I'll join the feast.
choices.reply: Then you're one of us. Wear this, and never fear hunger again.

choices.label: No. This ends now.
choices.reply: Pity. Namira will remember your refusal. Take this, anyway. She likes a bold palate, even a disappointing one.

quests.title: The Only Cure
quests.pitch: Kesh needs ingredients to speak with the Taskmaster. Bring vampire dust and a silver ingot. Then breathe the smoke, and listen.
quests.desc: Kesh the Clean needs vampire dust and silver to burn the incense that lets Peryite speak.

quests.title: A Night to Remember
quests.pitch: Ha! Drink up. Here, this one's on me. And this one. And this one...
quests.desc: I accepted a drinking contest from a stranger named Sam Guevenne. I don't remember much after the third mug.

objectives.text: Match Sam mug for mug (bring three bottles of Nord Mead)
objectives.topic: Three for you, three for me.

objectives.text: Talk to Sam at Misty Grove
objectives.reply: What didn't? You were a legend. I'm Sanguine, by the way. Sorry about the mess. Here, you've earned this.

quests.title: The Mind of Madness
quests.pitch: Sheogorath! The Mad God! He went into Pelagius's mind, and Pelagius has been dead for centuries! Go to the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace and fetch him out.
quests.desc: A madman in Solitude says his master, Sheogorath, is lost inside the mind of a long-dead emperor, and the way in is the sealed Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace.

objectives.text: Walk through the Gates of Madness to New Sheoth and the Mad God's palace

quests.title: Waking Nightmare
quests.pitch: Vaermina. Her priests were sealed in the Nightcaller Temple long ago with something that feeds on dreams. The seal is breaking. Come with me, and we'll end it.
quests.desc: Dawnstar is plagued by nightmares. Erandur, a priest of Mara who once served Vaermina, wants to cleanse the Nightcaller Temple.

objectives.text: Go to the Nightcaller Temple with Erandur

choices.label: Destroy it, Erandur.
choices.reply: Thank you. Mara's mercy on us both. Dawnstar will sleep tonight.

choices.label: I'm keeping the Skull.
choices.reply: Then you're no better than I was. Go, and may Mara forgive you.
